entry.summary: Welcome to My Research Portfolioofficial website | linkedin | github | owlstown | faculty.bio | carrd | wix | academiaWelcome to my digital research space. I'm Dr. Shahadat Hussain, an Associate Research Scientist in the Division of Engineering at New York University Abu Dhabi, specializing in TPMS metamaterials, additive manufacturing, and advanced materials characterization.With over four years of hands-on experience in fabricating, testing, and analyzing additively manufactured structures—especially NiTi shape memory alloys and TPMS lattices—I bridge the gap between innovative design and real-world engineering applications.Here, you’ll find my latest projects, publications, and insights into the evolving field of smart materials and additive manufacturing.Featured Work🔬 Additive Manufacturing of NiTi Shape Memory AlloysExploring laser powder bed fusion of triply periodic minimal surface (TPMS) structures for enhanced mechanical and functional properties.📊 Data-Driven Materials AnalysisUsing Python (pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib) and Origin Lab for microstructure analysis, fatigue prediction, and visualization.🧲 Magnetic & Thermo-Responsive Shape Memory MaterialsDeveloping Cu-based shape memory alloys with high transition temperatures for engineering applications.Recent PublicationHussain, S., Mehraj, H., Moustafa, M. et al. Do chopped fibers matter? Process–structure–property relationships and thermal annealing effects in fiber-reinforced TPMS lattices. Prog Addit Manuf 11, 8199–8219 (2026). https://doi.org/10.1007/s40964-026-01791-9 Hussain, S., Alagha, A.N. & Zaki, W. Phase Transformation Behavior of NiTi Triply Periodic Minimal Surface Lattices Fabricated by Laser Powder Bed Fusion. J. of Materi Eng and Perform 34, 1136–1148 (2025). https://doi.org/10.1007/s11665-024-09162-7
